name: How do I ensure the framing is done correctly for my bathroom addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I ensure the framing is done correctly for my bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensuring correct framing for your bathroom addition involves several key steps. First, hire an experienced general contractor who has a proven track record with additions. They will work with licensed structural engineers and adhere strictly to approved architectural plans and local building codes. Regular inspections by city officials at various stages of framing are mandatory and help verify compliance. A reputable contractor will also maintain clear communication, allowing you to understand the progress and address any concerns promptly.
acceptedAnswer.description: To ensure correct framing, hire an experienced general contractor who works with engineers and adheres to plans and codes. City inspections and clear communication are also vital.
